claims: Warner Bros. announced on March 25, 2026, that Stephen Colbert is co-writing a new Lord of the Rings film titled The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past.
Shadow of the Past will focus on early chapters of The Fellowship of the Ring omitted from the original trilogy.
Shadow of the Past specifically features Sam, Merry, and Pippin in a new adventure.
Shadow of the Past follows Sam, Merry, and Pippin 14 years after the events of The Return of the King.
Gizmodo notes that Sam, Merry, and Pippin retrace their initial steps in the story of The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past.
According to NPR, The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past draws inspiration from chapters 3-8 of The Fellowship of the Ring from "Three is Company" to "Fog on the Barrow-downs".
Shadow of the Past was developed by Colbert and his son over two years before being pitched to Peter Jackson.
According to Entertainment Weekly, The Lord of the Rings: Shadow of the Past is planned as a separate future project following the upcoming film The Hunt for Gollum.
According to Entertainment Weekly, The Hunt for Gollum is slated for 2027.
